question: At the fixed calibrated 135Ba lowest J=11/2 state, which coupling interventions alter the J+2 proxy raw argument/domain, and how does signed full cubic closure cancel?

electromagnetic_operator.policy: recompute the same scalar calibration once as an identity check; then hold eB/eF/chiE/v2/Qjj fixed for every intervention

state_selection.tracked_companion: Maximum squared overlap within all J=11/2 states; report rank and overlap to previous grid point and t=1 reference; do not relabel a different eigenstate as the lowest state

refinement.trigger: Adjacent raw proxy-all argument changes by >=0.15, adjacent lowest-state fidelity <0.85, either same-J gap <0.10 MeV, or rigid-domain status changes
refinement.selection: Among triggered adjacent base intervals, choose largest absolute proxy-all raw-argument change; insert quarter, midpoint, three-quarter points once
refinement.interpretation: deterministic sensitivity resolution, not a confidence interval or parameter tuning

hypotheses_before_controls: H1: Couplings redistribute full q2 into static and other same-J as well as J+/-1 and J+/-2 channels; static and same-J-excited pieces must be separated.
H2: The full near-zero signed cubic ratio results from cancellation among complete signed 6j spin-pair sectors; the proxy retains one unweighted absolute chain and can cross its arccos domain.
H3: A one-term removal can identify a conditional driver of the anomaly only if state identity/gap and the signed E2 network changes support the intervention, not from P(core R=0) alone.
H4: A sharp proxy change may reflect an avoided crossing/level switch or intermediate-channel redistribution; energy ordering and overlap diagnostics must separate these possibilities.
outputs_per_case: direct and full6j q2/q3 and residuals
signed raw full ratio and conditional signed/folded angles
J+2 n5/all raw arguments and domain statuses
q2 spin fractions and static/other same-J split
signed cubic ordered spin-pair sectors; positive/negative sums and cancellation

compactness: No full RME matrix, state-pair tensor, or eigenvector array written. Keep scalar summaries, <=25 cubic spin-pair sectors/case, small proxy diagnostics and adjacent overlaps.
